snippet.title: Halloween  - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the Boogeyman or fight against evil itself in Halloween, the latest singleplayer and multiplayer horror experience from @IllFonic  and @GunInteractive 

@HalloweenTVG is coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

https://halloweengame.com/

Stay sharp and follow @HalloweenTVG on X, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok or join the games subreddit at r/HalloweenTVG.
